title: macos-latest Test step wedges to the 20-minute job timeout on main pushes (evidence for a pending decision)
description: EVIDENCE ONLY; carrier for a decision opum-doc is taking. No ci.yml change and no fix until it returns. Job "lint . typecheck . test (macos-latest)", step "Test". Every wedge is a cancel at the job timeout-minutes: 20 (~20m20s), never a test failure. LEADER-MEASURED 2026-10-23 ~00:55Z: across 43 macOS job attempts on the last 40 main-push CI runs, 13 timeout wedges, 2 failures, 28 successes; since 2026-10-06, 9 wedges in 20 attempts; earliest wedge in that window is run 36492715205 (2026-09-28T22:29Z), so it predates LCLI-753. Recent wedges: 39873358281 attempts 1 and 2 (96f362cf; job 120152888119 then 120160392681), 39857558436 (6ff69788), 39433868424 (3aa5f020), 39360965506 (85d583c8), 37849280452, 37673274449, 37509680700, 37503495906, 36543946885, 36506568128, 36501610178, 36492715205. Same-SHA contrast: run 39857554409 at 6ff69788, started 2 s from the wedged 39857558436, passed macOS in ~8 min. SIGNATURE (leader): last (pass) line 2-18 s after the step starts, then ~19.5 min of silence until "The operation was canceled."; the last test differs each time (a runCheck case in three wedges, jobs 120152888119, 120099617794, 118665643969; a release.yml LCLI-621 case in 39873358281 attempt 2); --timeout=10000 never fires, so the bun process itself goes silent; cleanup reports "Terminate orphan process: pid (3654) (bun)". CONFIG: macos-latest falls through to ci.yml else branch `bun test --isolate --timeout=10000` with no outer timeout and no hung-only retry; ubuntu-latest bounds the same class of wedge with `timeout --kill-after=10s 6m` plus the LCLI-659 classifier retry. COVERAGE: macOS does not run on PRs (ci.yml matrix), so it is seen only after promotion. NOT COVERED by LCLI-753 (#654 bounded only the browser job install step) or LCLI-759 (browser job apt stall, a different job).
